wire.sessions_remote_stop.approval_stop_: stop {address} on {peer} if it is idle there: its device ends it only when it confirms it idle, and never signals; refused while it is working
wire.sessions_remote_stop.force_refused: A session on another device can only be stopped idle-only from here: force is never sent to a peer, so nothing was sent. The operator can force-stop it on that device.
wire.sessions_remote_stop.not_running: "{name}" is not running on {peer}, so there was nothing to stop.
wire.sessions_remote_stop.relay_restart: This device's relay is older than this build and cannot send an idle-only stop, so nothing was sent. Restart it with `lop network restart`, then try again.
wire.sessions_remote_stop.unconfirmed: Unconfirmed: the idle-only stop may or may not have reached {peer}, and nothing was retried. Check with `sessions op=list peer={peer}` before trying again.
wire.sessions_remote_stop.unsupported: {peer} runs a build without the idle-only stop, so nothing was sent and nothing was stopped. Update that device, or ask the operator to stop the session there.
